Configured Initial Review (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-15) with Originality 1-5 weight 2, Relevance 1-5 weight 1, Recommendation select, Comments text; Final Review (2026-10-16 to 2026-11-30) with Final Score 1-10 and Comments.

items.reasoning: Each round has its own REVIEWER POOL checkboxes. Final Review screenshot shows only Linus Reviewer checked while Ada and Sam are unchecked; Initial Review pool included Sam Whitfield among others. Membership is scoped per round, not only globally.
evidence_refs: obs: Evaluation Plan supports ... reviewer pools, and per-round dates.

items.reasoning: Organizer scorecard editor supports Rating (numeric), Select (dropdown), and Text criteria. Reviewer side rendered Originality/Relevance sliders, Recommendation dropdown (Accept), and Comments textarea; values 4, 2, Accept and the sample comment were submitted and later visible in organizer Review Studio history and Results review math.
evidence_refs: obs: Review history shows Sam Whitfield stored Originality 4, Relevance 2, Accept and the exact comment.

items.reasoning: Weight fields exist in the scorecard editor (Originality weight 2, Relevance weight 1) and render on the reviewer scorecard as 2×/1×. Per-review weighted math for the 4/2 scores is shown as 3.33/5 normalized in Results review math; overall submission aggregate is 3.67 due to a second pooled review, which the rubric allows.
evidence_refs: obs: Taming includes pooled earlier review (2 reviews), explaining 3.67 versus single-review weighted 3.33.

items.reasoning: Organizer assigned exactly the two requested titles to Sam Whitfield. Sam's reviewer queue listed only 'Taming 40-Minute CI' and 'Your AI Pair Programmer'; unassigned 'Docs That Answer Back' was absent.
evidence_refs: obs: Sam Whitfield reviewer queue shows exactly two assigned submissions: Taming 40-Minute CI... and Your AI Pair Programmer...; unassigned Docs That Answer Back is absent.

items.reasoning: Assignments UI exposes Per-reviewer limit (set to 5) and an Auto-distribute control, plus multi-select assign. Agent used the limit and assigned two selected submissions successfully.
evidence_refs: obs: Assignments UI provides per-reviewer limit (set/displayed 5) and Auto-distribute.

items.reasoning: Per-round Blind review setting exists. Reviewer view of Taming shows 'Blind review — author identity redacted' with Anonymous speaker and no Priya Raman, Marcus Okafor, or Latticework Systems. Organizer Review Studio shows Priya (lead), Marcus (co-author), emails, and Latticework bio.
evidence_refs: obs: Reviewer view explicitly says Blind review — author identity redacted. Visible submission contains no Priya Raman, Marcus Okafor, or company identity.

items.reasoning: Live per-reviewer completion dashboard exists and updated after Sam submitted (from 1 of 3 / 33% to 3 of 3 / 100%). Meaningful gap: baseline was never the expected 2 assigned / 0 complete because seeded/pooled data gave Sam 3 assignments with 1 already complete, so the exact before/after 2/0 → 2/2 contract is not met even though counts track real state.
evidence_refs: obs: Review Progress Initial Review shows Sam Whitfield 3 of 3 complete, 100% (not 2 of 2; pooled/earlier review adds a third assignment).

items.reasoning: Review Progress has bulk 'Remind outstanding reviewers'. After click the UI showed '3 reminder(s) logged' as confirmation, satisfying the sent-status/log requirement even though the agent initially missed a toast.

Results table shows per-submission aggregates (AI Pair 5.00, Taming 3.67 including pooled reviews). Default descending ranks AI Pair above Taming; switching to Score · low to high reorders Taming above AI Pair.
evidence_refs: obs: Default descending order correctly ranks AI Pair above Taming.

items.reasoning: CFP form supports co-authors with role Co-author; review step showed Priya as Speaker and Marcus as Co-author. Organizer Review Studio shows Priya Raman (lead) and Marcus Okafor (co-author) with emails; submissions list shows 'Priya Raman + Marcus Okafor'.

Reviewer scoring view includes a red 'Declare conflict / recuse' control scoped to the submission. Assignments page also has a RECUSED ASSIGNMENTS section for reinstatement. Control presence with recorded wording meets pass; exercise was not required for full credit.
evidence_refs: obs: Conflict control is present with exact wording 'Declare conflict / recuse'

items.reasoning: Results page has Export CSV. Triggering it moved the control into a disabled 'Exporting…' state, confirming the download action initiated without error.
evidence_refs: obs: Export CSV control was triggered; UI changed to disabled 'Exporting…' during download, confirming export action.

items.reasoning: Clone claims AI-assisted triage (Evaluation Plan banner and reviewer 'AI draft review' button; Results notes AI drafts are advisory). Feature exists in UI but agent did not exercise producing a numeric AI score with rationale, nor a distinguishable AI-vs-human result or persisted human override, so the full pass condition is only half-observable.
evidence_refs: obs: AI scores were not visibly presented in Results; page labels human review aggregates and says AI drafts are advisory only. No AI override control was found.
